title: Blue versus red background color and perceived download speed
statement:
Blue background colors make web pages feel like they download faster compared to red backgrounds due to the relaxing properties of lower-arousal colors.

Options:
- Low-arousal cooling: #E3F2FD (Light Blue) (fits: data heavy, long load times)
- Neutral baseline: #FFFFFF (White) (fits: standard ui)
- High-arousal alerting: #FFEBEE (Light Red) (fits: flash sales, urgent actions)
appliesWhen: Applies to: ecommerce, saas, complex dashboards. Audience: general.

source.title: Waiting for the Web: How Screen Color Affects Time Perception
source.authors: Gerald J. Gorn; Amitava Chattopadhyay; Jaideep Sengupta; Sanjay Tripathi
